jobs.title: Vice President, HR AI Enablement
jobs.description:
An exciting career awaits you

At MPC, we’re committed to being a great place to work – one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.

Job Summary:

The Vice President, HR AI Enablement leads the HR aspects of our enterprise AI acceleration initiative. This includes ensuring workforce readiness, enabling adoption of AI tools and processes, and aligning talent strategies to support AI-forward business transformation. This role also oversees enterprise Talent Management, Learning, and Leadership Development functions, ensuring our workforce has the skills, development, and support to succeed in a rapidly evolving AI enabled workplace. In addition, this role oversees HR Business Partners dedicated to our HR and IT functions, providing strategic guidance to support leaders in the maximization of team performance and productivity. This role serves as a key member of the human resources leadership team and provides leadership in all aspects of HR AI. The position reports to the CHRO & SVP Communications and will lead a team of HR Leaders and individual contributors.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and drive the enterprise workforce strategy, defining how employees and AI work together to improve operations, elevate decision-making, and unlock productivity.  Design frameworks that clearly specify ethical, effective, and accountable use of AI across the organization.

- Drive the vision, governance, and cross-functional alignment to integrate AI into business processes that maximizes value, manages risk, and supports continuous improvement, including setting priorities for AI adoption, aligning technology leadership with business goals, ensuring funding and resources for AI initiatives, and fostering a culture of trust, accountability, and adaptability in AI collaborations.

- Provide HR leadership in enterprise-wide AI initiatives and partner with business leaders and global process owners to translate initiatives and insights into actionable strategies. Act as a domain authority in HR, providing guidance on our workforce strategy, AI investments and roadmap prioritization.

- Build the AI-forward workforce value measurement system, establishing baseline KPI’s, defining outcomes and efficiency metrics, and validating impact and ROI.

- Manage the evolving landscape of HR related AI legal and regulatory compliance and stay abreast of technology advancements and opportunities.

- Lead the design and execution of enterprise-wide Talent Management strategies, incorporating AI tools to improve talent management, development, and retention.

- Accelerate the utilization of AI solutions to enhance decision-making in performance management, succession planning, and workforce development.

- Oversee Learning & Development programs, including the design of AI-enabled learning pathways that enhance growth opportunities for all employees.

- Direct Leadership Development initiatives to prepare leaders to manage change, navigate complexity and drive high performance.

- Manage HR Business Partners supporting HR and IT, ensuring delivery of strategic, data informed guidance to maximize employee experience and business performance and productivity.

Required Experience / Education:
- Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Technology, Data Science, Computer Science, or other accredited fields of study

- 10 years of progressive leadership experience in HR technology transformation, leading enterprise-wide talent strategies, strategic change management, employee experience, or enterprise enablement; including required experience leading a team of HR professionals.

- Proven track record leading enterprise-scale business transformations that leverage artificial intelligence, automation, data, and/or digital technologies to fundamentally improve HR and business outcomes.

- Demonstrated success redesigning operating models, optimizing end-to-end workflows, and rearchitecting technology ecosystems to improve efficiency, scalability, agility, and business outcomes.

- Proven experience designing skills-based talent and capability models and leading enterprise workforce upskilling and reskilling strategies to build future-ready organizational capabilities.

- Demonstrated success designing and executing enterprise-wide talent strategies that integrate AI-enabled or digital tools and insights to accelerate talent development, strengthen retention, and improve workforce outcomes.

- Proven ability to establish an HR AI value measurement system, including baseline KPIs outcome and efficiency metrics, impact validation, and measurement of business value and ROI.

- Demonstrated understanding of AI governance frameworks, data privacy standards, responsible AI principles, and cybersecurity protocols required to safely and effectively deploy AI applications across the enterprise.

Preferred Experience:
- Advanced Degree such as an MBA

- Experience leading HR, technology, or business transformation within complex industrial, manufacturing, energy, or other asset-intensive organizations with large, distributed workforces.

- 5+ years of HR or technology consulting with a leading consulting firm advising Fortune 1000 companies on complex HR or IT strategies, transformations and implementations.

- Proven ability to leverage technology, data, and AI to enhance the employee experience, strengthen employee listening strategies, and modernize HR products, services, and offerings.

- Early-career or recent experience as an HR Business Partner supporting HR, IT, or other corporate functions, with demonstrated understanding of business operations, workforce needs, and organizational dynamics.

- Demonstrated experience leading or transforming an IT organization toward an AI-forward operating model, including establishing AI strategy and governance, embedding AI capabilities across the technology portfolio, and developing the talent and culture required to scale AI adoption.

jobs.title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer, GRC Automation and Continuous Control Monitoring
jobs.description:
An exciting career awaits you

At MPC, we’re committed to being a great place to work – one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.

Position Summary

The GRC Automation & Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM) Senior Cybersecurity Engineer is a strategic and technical role, responsible or helping turn GRC into a trust engine for the business: reducing audit friction, improving business risk exposure visibility, accelerating evidence readiness, and enabling stronger operational confidence.
The role serves as the technical focal for GRC automation, developing automated evidence collection, control testing, risk intelligence, and AI-enabled governance capabilities across cloud, on-premises, identity, operational technology (OT), and security platforms. The role collaborates closely with Cyber Fusion, Enterprise Architecture, and Cyber Engineering, to design and build deterministic control-testing logic where deterministic approaches are enough; and AI agents and LLM-backed workflows where reasoning, summarization, or judgment is required, such as evidence-to-control mapping, attestation drafting, drift detection, and audit-package assembly.
This position belongs to a family of jobs with increasing responsibility, competency, and skill level. Actual position title and pay grade will be based on the selected candidate’s experience and qualifications.
Key Responsibilities

- Conducts detailed analyses on changes to cybersecurity solutions and its relationship to internal and external systems to assess control effectiveness and cybersecurity risk. Resolves complex multi-functional technical issues.
- Leverages cybersecurity assessments, standards, control testing methodologies, and compliance frameworks to ensure compliance across security systems.
- Improves the efficiency and effectiveness of Security solutions, governance processes, automated controls, and monitoring capabilities.
- Analyzes existing processes and procedures and leads efforts for implementing improvements, automation opportunities, or remediation activities.
- Responsible for development and submission of Standard Operating Procedures.
- Analyzes business impacting events, performs initial investigation, and evaluates control performance, exceptions, and risk indicators through continuous monitoring activities.
- Investigates and analyzes the nature and scope of cyber incidents, control failures, and compliance exceptions. Assists in the development of risk mitigation and remediation plans to ensure regulatory and internal compliance. compliance.
- Leads implementation of global security initiatives, policies, compliance requirements, and continuous control monitoring practices. Collects, validates, and reports security metrics, control performance results, and remediation efforts associated with them.
- Manages cyber security-related consulting, guidance, and support to customers and stakeholders.
- Translates security principles to assist configuration teams with incorporating security and compliance requirements into build and configuration processes.
- Monitors emerging IT/OT, cybersecurity, automation, and artificial intelligence technologies as well as their impact on the security, risk, and compliance landscape.

Education and Experience

- Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, related field or equivalent experience.
- 5+ years of relevant experience required
- Experience designing, implementing, and scaling GRC, CCM, or compliance automation solutions within a regulated environment required
- Experience in Python or comparable automation technologies, proficient in developing, integrating, and supporting automated workflows and REST API-based data integrations across multiple enterprise systems required.
- Hands-on experience integrating security-control data sources into a GRC / CCM evidence pipeline for continuous control testing required. This includes normalizing API, telemetry, configuration, vulnerability, identity, ticketing, and assessment data into control-level evidence, exception logic, ownership, frequency, and audit-ready records across at least three domains such as CNAPP / CSPM, SIEM / security data lake / XDR, CTEM / VM / ASPM, DSPM, ITSM, IAM, GRC / CCM, or AI/agent governance required.
- Experience building LLM-backed agentic workflows on Azure AI Foundry, GitHub, or open-source frameworks preferred.
- Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, the OWASP LLM Top 10, or comparable AI risk frameworks preferred.

Skills

- Adaptability - Maintaining effectiveness when experiencing major changes in work responsibilities or environment (e.g., people, processes, structure, or culture); adjusting effectively to change by exploring the benefits, trying new approaches, and collaborating with others to make the change successful.
- AI Fundamentals - Understanding of core AI concepts and methods, ability to apply AI to job-relevant use cases and capacity to contribute to organizational AI reimagination.
- Change Management - Change Management refers to a systematic approach for defining and implementing procedures and/or technologies to deal with changes in the environment. It can mean adapting to change, controlling change and/or effecting change.
- Authentic Communicator - Expresses ideas and information, both verbally and in writing, clearly and credibly. Listens to understand and fosters constructive dialogue.
- Cybersecurity Risk Management - The process of developing cyber risk assessment and treatment techniques that can effectively pre-empt and identify significant security loopholes and weaknesses, demonstrating the business risks associated with these loopholes and providing risk treatment and prioritization strategies to effectively address the cyber-related risks, threats and vulnerabilities, ensuring appropriate levels of protection, confidentiality, integrity and privacy in alignment with the security framework.
- General Programming - Applies a computer language to communicate with computers using a set of instructions and to automate the execution of tasks.
- Intrusion Detection - The use of security analytics, including the outputs from intelligence analysis, predictive research and root cause analysis in order to search for and detect potential breaches or identify recognized indicators and warnings. Also, monitoring and collating external vulnerability reports for organizational relevance, ensuring that relevant vulnerabilities are rectified through formal change processes.
- Penetration Testing - The practice of testing a computer system, network or web application to find security vulnerabilities that an attacker could exploit. Penetration testing can be automated with software applications or performed manually.
- Relationship Management - Relationship Management is the conscious aim to develop and manage long-term and/or trusting relationships with internal or external customers, distributors, suppliers, or other parties in an environment which can include marketing, selling, servicing and other areas where a relationship is crucial to on-going success. At a senior level, it includes C-level relationships with senior management.
- Security Controls - Manages and maintains an information system that focuses on the management of risk and the management of information systems security.
- Security Governance - The process of developing and disseminating corporate security policies, frameworks and guidelines to ensure that day-to-day business operations are guarded and well protected against risks, threats and vulnerabilities.
- Security Information & Event Management (SIEM) - A set of tools and services offering real-time visibility across an organization's information security systems, and event log management that consolidates data from numerous sources.
- Security Policy Management - The process of identifying, implementing, and managing the rules and procedures that all individuals must follow when accessing and using an organization's IT assets and resources.
- Threat Analysis - Monitor intelligence-gathering and anticipate potential threats to an IT/OT systems proactively. This involves the pre-emptive analysis of potential perpetrators, anomalous activities and evidence-based knowledge and inferences on perpetrators' motivations and tactics.
- Threat Hunting - Searches through networks, endpoints, and datasets to detect and isolate cyber threats that evade existing security solutions.
- Vulnerability Management - The process of defining, identifying, classifying and prioritizing vulnerabilities in computer systems, applications and network infrastructures and providing the organization with the necessary knowledge, awareness and risk background to understand the threats to its business

jobs.title: Senior Human Resources Business Partner
jobs.description:
An exciting career awaits you

At MPC, we’re committed to being a great place to work – one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Human Resources Business Partner will have responsibility for a broad range of human resources functions in support of MPC’s Commercial Organization. Serving as a trusted advisor to business leaders, the Sr. HRBP provides strategic HR partnership across talent, organization, workforce, and business priorities.

This role requires a confident, business-minded HR professional who builds strong relationships while bringing sound judgment, independent perspective, and the ability to influence thoughtful people and business decisions. The Sr. HRBP works closely with leaders at all levels to understand business objectives, anticipate talent and organizational needs, and translate those needs into practical people strategies and solutions.

Successful Sr. HRBPs serve as employee champions, change agents, and strategic partners to the business. Specifically related to their assigned client groups, Sr. HRBPs will be expected to develop and maintain an effective level of business literacy and build strong partnerships across the organization. Key areas of partnership include talent and succession planning, performance and compensation, organizational effectiveness, workforce and capability planning, learning & development, employee relations, and execution of enterprise HR priorities. This role supports a dynamic, evolving organization with employees across corporate offices, field locations, and remote work environments across multiple time zones.

The position is part of a family of jobs with increasing levels of responsibility, competency, and skill. The title and pay grade of the position will be determined by the experience and qualifications of the selected candidate.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Implement HR strategies aligned with business needs through influence and change management. Develop and maintain strong relationships with client groups and leaders at all levels to drive business results, anticipate talent and organizational needs, and support talent reviews, succession planning, and related action plans.
- Promote and fosters inclusion and opportunity (I&O) in the workplace to support a high performing culture.
- Partner with assigned client groups in the interpretation and administration of human resources policies and programs involving employment, compensation, benefits, employee relations, talent processes, and other people-related matters. Provide guidance and solutions that are practical, consistent, and aligned with business needs and enterprise HR priorities.
- Guide and assist employees and leaders in the interpretation and administration of HR policies, procedures, practices, and programs. Apply sound judgment and business context to support consistent, practical, and credible people decisions.
- Provide performance and leadership consulting to client organizations, including training, needs assessments, organizational development, leadership development, and meeting facilitation. Collaborate with HR Centers of Excellence to develop strategies and solutions that respond to changing business needs.
- Responsible for conducting investigations for the preparation and presentation of facts leading to the resolution of employee disputes related to various issues.  Where applicable, participates in negotiations with employee unions and provides assistance in the interpretation and administration of labor contracts to include arbitration.
- Develop, lead, and/or assist with special projects, enterprise and client-group HR initiatives, annual people processes, and process improvements as assigned. Assimilate information, assess business impact, and recommend action based on findings, available funding, and organizational priorities.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:
- Bachelor’s degree required. Degree in Human Resources, Labor & Industrial Relations, or related field highly preferred.
- Four (4) or more years of related HR experience required. HR Business Partner or HR Generalist experience highly preferred.
- Prior experience in petroleum, utilities, manufacturing or related field is preferred.

SKILLS:
- Strong time management, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to work both collaboratively and independently to manage multiple priorities and meet organization needs simultaneously in a fast-paced, high-output environment with changing priorities and deadlines.
- Strong collaboration, consultation, and relationship management skills, including the ability to build effective working relationships with internal clients, external partners, and employees at all levels.
- Analytical skills and the ability to assimilate information, assess business impact, and recommend practical actions based on findings and organizational priorities.
- Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

COMPETENCIES:
- Comfortable working through ambiguity and limited information while engaging clients to reach clarity and alignment.
- Ability to apply sound judgment, business context, and practical guidance to support credible people and business decisions.
- Ability to demonstrate learning agility and intellectual curiosity by quickly building understanding of energy industry, business, and HR-related subject matter.
- Demonstrated detail orientation and analytical discipline to support accurate, thoughtful, and well-reasoned recommendations.
- Ability to demonstrate a partnership orientation by collaborating effectively and building productive relationships across teams, functions, and levels of the organization.

jobs.title: Human Resources Director - St. Paul Park Refining
jobs.description:
An exciting career awaits you

At MPC, we’re committed to being a great place to work – one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Human Resources Director (HRD) role provides comprehensive Human Resources (HR) expertise in areas such as employee/labor relations, staffing, compensation and benefits, and strategic planning to MPC’s St. Paul Park Refinery.

The HRD participates in business planning along with making strategic decisions and with strategy development for direction of the site as a member of the site leadership team. This role provides management and leadership support over the HR department to improve overall site performance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Provides strategic business partnering to business unit leaders to support business objectives, including direction and counsel on employee relations and development, organizational development, workforce and succession planning, inclusion & opportunity (I&O), performance management, and other HR policies and programs.
- Partners with HR Centers of Excellence (CoE) to implement HR programs in support of business objectives. Oversees delivery of human resources initiatives and programs (salary allocation and other compensation programs, performance management, leadership and career development, succession planning, I&O, and benefit plans).
- Provides guidance and counsel to individual HR team on significant matters related to the application of programs, policies, and processes.
- Engages with teams and employees across the organization to build trust, understand concerns and opportunities, and drive continuous improvement on employee relations so that MPC will continue to be the employer of choice.
- Provides strategic partnering and counsel to business leaders and the HR team on labor initiatives.
- Performs labor relations activities for the refinery, including negotiations, contract administration, arbitrations, and other union related business.
- Aligns HR team’s goals to MPC People Strategy and ensures that team activities also support client business unit objectives.
- Leads the administration of established compensation programs and policies such as salary administration, bonus plans, and employee recognition awards.
- Develops and reviews HR budget; initiates actions to ensure that budget expectations are met; reviews operating data and makes decisions on recommendations from staff and operating departments.
- Serves as Public Information Officer of the refinery Incident Management Team as the on-site communications lead and liaisons with the corporate communications team for external communications.
- Builds relationships with community stakeholders and collaborates with Government Affairs and Community Relations on local initiatives.
- Serves as a member of the site Local Giving Committee.
- Participates in quarterly Community Advisory Panel (CAP) meetings.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:
- Bachelor’s degree required. Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Labor & Industrial relations or related field.
- Minimum ten (10) years of broad HR experience required. Supervisory experience highly preferred.
- A Master's degree may be substituted for up to two (2) years of the required professional experience.
- Prior experience in petroleum, utilities, manufacturing or related field is preferred.

SKILLS:
- Knowledge and understanding of business, HR processes, and organizational processes; with the ability to think strategically and analytically
- Ability to develop and support a team
- Strong time management and organizational skills with the ability to communicate effectively
- Result orientated with an ability to work both independently and collaboratively to meet organization needs and goals
- Comfortable working with ambiguity and limited information and engaging clients to reach clarity
- Ability to manage multiple projects and organization needs simultaneously and work effectively in a fast-paced, high-output environment
- Adapts seamlessly to changing priorities and deadlines
- Strong collaboration skills and the ability to build good working relationships with internal clients and external partners
- High curiosity; eager to learn and understand a wide range of energy industry, business, and creative subject matter
- Advanced experience with relationship management (building healthy working relations and partnerships with all levels of employees)
- Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office applications to include Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
- Attention-to-detail, analytical and team oriented.

TRAVEL:
- Travel is required throughout the year to meet with clients and other key stakeholders, travel can increase throughout the year as business needs required.
